team_hfa_served_opener_posthoc_accuracy.classification_evidence: Declared sign; week-block interval spans both signs at this sample; no refuted mechanism and no positive control bounds an effect this size on the served stage.
team_hfa_served_opener_posthoc_accuracy.description: Team-and-stadium home edge (scripts/team_hfa.py construction), one offset-logistic coefficient per SD on the QW served stage at the opener 2020-25, pushes kept at 0.5, leave-one-season-out with nested offsets. Full coefficient +0.0563/SD, folds positive 6/6, halves +0.0885/+0.0361; record 841-662 v QW 836-667; changed 149 (76-71 v 71-76); in-sample minus held-out log loss +0.00036; intercept-only -0.00000.
team_hfa_served_opener_posthoc_accuracy.notes: Family team_hfa_served_2026_11_21: post-hoc served read made only to freeze the out-of-season coefficient for the 2026 Weeks 12-18 forward log; follows the close screen family team_hfa_2026_11_16, whose declared served look was not run (screen not a survivor). Not gating, not served.
team_hfa_served_opener_posthoc_accuracy.plain_summary: Adds each stadium's own past home edge to the model's pick probability for 2020-25 and checks the picks it would have changed.
